cross_state_adequacy_rule.SUPPORTED_PATTERN: cross_state_gap positive with SMD(vis vs img retention) >= 0.5 in the failing ROIs; imagery retention notably below vision
cross_state_adequacy_rule.meaning: vision common space validated does NOT imply state-transfer adequate

baseline_headroom_rule.BASELINE_LIMITATION_STRONG: ROI median (1-S0) in bottom-2 of primary ROIs AND median G_shared <= 0.005
baseline_headroom_rule.BASELINE_LIMITATION_PARTIAL: ROI median (1-S0) below cohort median AND median G_shared <= 0.01

low_K_rule.LOW_K_GLOBAL_BOTTLENECK_NOT_SUPPORTED: a passing ROI (ventral) uses the same or lower K than a failing ROI
low_K_rule.LOW_K_MAY_CONTRIBUTE_REGIONALLY: failing ROIs use strictly higher K than ventral with worse retention
low_K_rule.LOW_K_BOTTLENECK_PLAUSIBLE: K monotonically tracks G_shared across ROIs

identity_breadth.IDENTITY_BREADTH_ROBUST: no single identity-pair > 35% of total positive ventral increment AND both families positive median contribution
